_comment: STM32U585VIT6Q signal pins: pin label -> [net, the ST signal the firmware muxes onto it, or GPIO/ANALOG]. Chosen so each bus leaves the package on the side facing its destination (MCU flipped + 180 deg on the back face: pins 1-25 east, 26-50 south, 51-75 west, 76-100 north): display SPI south toward J_TFT, touch/gauge I2C3 + touch INT/RST east toward J_CTP and the gauge, camera DCMI/SCCB (I2C2) north/west toward J_CAM, ordered on the north side as J_CAM orders them (XCLK from TIM3_CH2 PWM, RST east of VSYNC), secure elements (SE050 + OPTIGA, one I2C4 bus, each its own reset) west, radio USART3 (PB10/PB11) and RADIO_OFF at the south-west corner, around the corner from the radio gate west of the package (USART1 on PA9/PA10 trial-routed worse: two more west-side pins in the camera bus's escape); VBUS sensed on a plain GPIO (the USB stack's hardware VBUS sensing is off), charger/button east. Mcu.tsx draws the traces from this table and scripts/checkMcuAf.py fails unless every signal is listed for that pin in ST's own pin database.
